26478-the-wallypug-in-london.title: Wallypug In London
26478-the-wallypug-in-london.creator: G. E. Farrow
26478-the-wallypug-in-london.description: A book by G. E. Farrow. The grandest sight the world hath ever seen  Thy kingdom offers. Clothed in fair array,  The Majesty of Love and Peace serene,  While hosts unnumbered loyalty display,  Striving to show, by every loving art,  The day for them can have no counterpart. sixty years of joy and sorrowing  For Queen and People, either borrowing  From other sympathy, in woe or glee,  Hath knit their hearts to thine, wherefore they sing--  Victoria's children sing her Jubilee.

arxiv-2205-04742.title: Cloudlet Capture Model for Asymmetric Molecular Emission Lines Observed in TMC-1A with ALMA Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2205-04742.creator: Tomoyuki Hanawa, Nami Sakai, Satoshi Yamamoto
arxiv-2205-04742.description: Abstract TMC-1A is a protostellar source harboring a young protostar, IRAS 04365+2353, and shows a highly asymmetric features of a few 100 au scale in the molecular emission lines. Blue-shifted emission is much stronger in the CS ( J = 5 J=5 -4) line than red-shifted one.

arxiv-2206-07524.title: Solving Fuzzy Quadratic Programming Problems with a Proposed Algorithm
arxiv-2206-07524.creator: Sajal Chakroborty
arxiv-2206-07524.description: Abstract The theory of fuzzy mathematics has been proven very effective for defining and solving optimization problems. Fuzzy quadratic programming (FQP) is a consequence of this approach. In this paper, an algorithm has been proposed to solve FQP with coefficients as triangular fuzzy numbers (TFN). The proposed algorithm converts FQP into two parametric quadratic programming (QP) problems.

arxiv-2302-14125.title: A Note on the Faces of the Dual Koch Arrangement
arxiv-2302-14125.creator: Bernd Gärtner, Manuel Wettstein
arxiv-2302-14125.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Bernd Gärtner, Manuel Wettstein. We analyze the faces of the dual Koch arrangement, which is the arrangement of 2 s + 1 2^{s}+1 lines obtained by projective duality from the Koch chain K s K_{s} . In particular, we show that this line arrangement does not contain any k k -gons for k > 5 k>5 , and that the number of pentagons is 3 ⋅ 2 s − 1 − 3 3\cdot 2^{s-1}-3 .

arxiv-2303-13802.title: Decoupled Multimodal Distilling for Emotion Recognition
arxiv-2303-13802.creator: Yong Li, Yuanzhi Wang, Zhen CuiPCA Lab, Key Lab of Intelligent Perception and Systems for High-DimensionalInformation of Ministry of Education, School of Computer Science and Engineering,Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing, China. {yong.li, yuanzhiwang, zhen.cui}@njust.edu.cn
arxiv-2303-13802.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yong Li, Yuanzhi Wang, Zhen CuiPCA Lab, Key Lab of Intelligent Perception and Systems for High-DimensionalInformation of Ministry of Education, School of Computer Science and Engineering,Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing, China. {yong.li, yuanzhiwang, zhen.cui}@njust.edu.cn. Human multimodal emotion recognition (MER) aims to perceive human emotions via language, visual and acoustic modalities. Despite the impressive performance of previous MER approaches, the inherent multimodal heterogeneities still haunt and the contribution of different modalities varies significantly.

arxiv-2305-06226.title: RiverBench: an Open RDF Streaming Benchmark Suite
arxiv-2305-06226.creator: Piotr Sowiński, Maria Ganzha, Marcin Paprzycki
arxiv-2305-06226.description: Abstract RDF streaming has been explored by the Semantic Web community from many angles, resulting in multiple task formulations and streaming methods. However, for many existing formulations of the problem, reliably benchmarking streaming solutions has been challenging due to the lack of well-described and appropriately diverse benchmark datasets.

arxiv-2401-04498.title: Efficient designs for multivariate crossover trials
arxiv-2401-04498.creator: Shubham Niphadkar, Siuli Mukhopadhyay
arxiv-2401-04498.description: Abstract This article aims to study efficient/trace optimal designs for crossover trials with multiple responses recorded from each subject in the time periods. A multivariate fixed effects model is proposed with direct and carryover effects corresponding to the multiple responses.

arxiv-2403-10471.title: C. Maccaferri
arxiv-2403-10471.creator: (a)
arxiv-2403-10471.description: Abstract SISSA 04/2024/FISI Adding stubs to quantum string field theories Abstract Generalizing recent work by Schnabl-Stettinger and Erbin-Fırat, we outline a universal algebraic procedure for ‘adding stubs’ to string field theories obeying the BV quantum master equation. We apply our results to classical and quantum closed string field theory as well as to open-closed string field theory.

arxiv-2410-09248.title: Exploring Non-Isotropic Lorentz Invariance Violation Through Sidereal Effect at DUNE
arxiv-2410-09248.creator: Shashank Mishra, Saurabh Shukla, Lakhwinder Singh, Venktesh Singh
arxiv-2410-09248.description: Abstract Lorentz Invariance Violation (LIV) presents an intriguing opportunity to investigate fundamental symmetries, with neutrinos serving as a particularly effective probe for this phenomenon. Long-baseline neutrino experiments, such as the Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment (DUNE), excel at exploring non-isotropic LIV, especially through the observation of sidereal effects.

arxiv-2411-05494.title: Numerical investigation of quantum phases and phase transitions in a two-leg ladder of Rydberg atoms
arxiv-2411-05494.creator: Jose Soto Garcia, Natalia Chepiga
arxiv-2411-05494.description: Abstract Experiments on chains of Rydberg atoms appear as a new playground to study quantum phase transitions in 1D. As a natural extension, we report a quantitative ground-state phase diagram of Rydberg atoms arranged in a two-leg ladder interacting via van der Waals potential. We address this problem numerically, using the Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) algorithm.

arxiv-2502-03071.title: Hodge theory and o-minimality at CIRM
arxiv-2502-03071.creator: Gregorio Baldi
arxiv-2502-03071.description: Abstract . We discuss the relationship between o-minimality and the so called Zilber-Pink conjecture. Since the work of Pila and Zannier, algebraization theorems in o-minimal geometry had profound impacts in Diophantine geometry (most notably on the study of special points in abelian and Shimura varieties).

arxiv-2503-22538.title: Scaling limit for the random walk on critical lattice trees
arxiv-2503-22538.creator: Gérard Ben Arous, Manuel Cabezas, Alexander Fribergh
arxiv-2503-22538.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gérard Ben Arous, Manuel Cabezas, Alexander Fribergh. We prove a scaling limit theorem for the simple random walk on critical lattice trees in ℤ d \mathbb{Z}^{d} , for d ≥ 8 d\geq 8 . The scaling limit is the Brownian motion on the Integrated Super-Brownian Excursion (BISE) which is the same one that we have identified earlier for other simpler models of anomalous diffusion on critical graphs in large enough dimension.

arxiv-2511-20609.title: Adaptive Hopfield Network: Rethinking Similarities in Associative Memory
arxiv-2511-20609.creator: Shurong Wang, Yuqi Pan, Zhuoyang Shen, Meng Zhang, Hongwei Wang & Guoqi Li
arxiv-2511-20609.description: Abstract Associative memory models are content-addressable memory systems fundamental to biological intelligence and are notable for their high interpretability. However, existing models evaluate the quality of retrieval based on proximity, which cannot guarantee that the retrieved pattern has the strongest association with the query, failing correctness.

arxiv-2512-19677.title: Detecting Coordinated Activities Through Temporal, Multiplex, and Collaborative Analysis
arxiv-2512-19677.creator: Letizia Iannucci, Elisa Muratore, Antonis Matakos, Mikko Kivelä
arxiv-2512-19677.description: Abstract In the era of widespread online content consumption, effective detection of coordinated efforts is crucial for mitigating potential threats arising from information manipulation. Despite advances in isolating inauthentic and automated actors, the actions of individual accounts involved in influence campaigns may not stand out as anomalous if analyzed independently of the coordinated group.

arxiv-2606-25850.title: Harnessing electrostatics through temperature modulations to control ferroelectrics
arxiv-2606-25850.creator: Cameron Scott, Xabier Diaz de Cerio, Jorge Íñiguez-González

plos-pone-0001805.title: Comparative Analysis of Acinetobacters: Three Genomes for Three Lifestyles
plos-pone-0001805.creator: David Vallenet, Patrice Nordmann, Valérie Barbe et al.
plos-pone-0001805.description: PLOS ONE research article. Acinetobacter baumannii is the source of numerous nosocomial infections in humans and therefore deserves close attention as multidrug or even pandrug resistant strains are increasingly being identified worldwide. Here we report the comparison of two newly sequenced genomes of A.

pmc-10526939.title: Focus on Multidisciplinary Aspects of Sleep Medicine
pmc-10526939.creator: Alessandro Cicolin, Luigi Ferini-Strambi
pmc-10526939.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). seases, but it is also well known that sleep disorders significantly increase the risk of cardiovascular, neurological, and oncologic disease, and that they can deeply modify the outcome of coexisting medical conditions [1,2,3,4]. The consequences of undiagnosed and untreated sleep disorders result in a significant economic burden, represented by associated healthcare costs and indirect financial costs, mainly due to absenteeism, reduced productivity, as well as work-related and traffic accident [5,6].

pmc-10672966.title: A Low-Cost Microfluidic and Optically Transparent Water Antenna with Frequency-Tuning Characteristics
pmc-10672966.creator: Abdullah Abdullah, Syed Imran Hussain Shah, Sakobyly Kiv, Jinwoo Ho, Sungjoon Lim, Liangliang Lin, Wei He
pmc-10672966.description: In this study, a novel microfluidic frequency reconfigurable and optically transparent water antenna is designed using three-dimensional (3D) printing technology. The proposed antenna consists of three distinct parts, including a circularly shaped distilled water ground, a sea water-based circular segmented radiator, and a circularly shaped distilled water-based load, all ingeniously constructed from transparent resin material.

pmc-10736789.title: BEHAVIORAL HEALTH INTERVENTIONS IN THE HOSPICE SETTING: A SCOPING REVIEW
pmc-10736789.creator: Lilla Brody, Karolina Sadowska, Alexis Holllingsworth, Michael Ong, Tejas Subramanian, Drew Wright, M Cary Reid, Daniel Shalev
pmc-10736789.description: Hospice is a model of care for individuals with a life expectancy of less than six months who choose to focus their treatment on quality-of-life rather than extending life. In 2019, half of all Medicare decedents elected to receive hospice care. Behavioral health comorbidities are prevalent in hospice patients; approximately 40% experience significant depression and/or anxiety.

pmc-11360044.title: Study on the Synergistic Effect of SiO2 and H2O on Oxidative Coupling of Methane over Mn–Na2WO4/SiO2 Catalyst
pmc-11360044.creator: Qingjing Liu, Ruisheng Wang, Ranjia Li, Xiaosheng Wang, Suoqi Zhao, Changchun Yu
pmc-11360044.description: Mn–Na2WO4-based catalysts with different supports were prepared using the incipient wetness impregnation method and evaluated for their oxidative coupling of methane (OCM) reaction performance. The results demonstrated that the SiO2- supported catalyst exhibited the best catalytic performance, and the introduction of H2O further enhanced its activity.

pmc-11667671.title: Spatial optimization of industrial symbiosis for heat supply of agricultural greenhouses
pmc-11667671.creator: Farzaneh Rezaei, Vanessa Burg, Stephan Pfister, Stefanie Hellweg, Ramin Roshandel
pmc-11667671.description: Despite the many benefits of greenhouses, it is challenging to meet their heating demand, as greenhouses belong to the most energy-intensive production systems in the agriculture sector. Industrial symbiosis can bring an effective solution by utilizing waste heat from other industries to meet the greenhouse heat demand.

pmc-12537562.title: Understanding barriers to HIV care and treatment adherence in Guyana and the Caribbean: A mixed-methods analysis
pmc-12537562.creator: Tariq Jagnarine
pmc-12537562.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights•Stigma and access barriers dominate.•Socioeconomic disparities influence access.•Adherence and clinic engagement challenges.•Drivers of disengagement from care.•Effectiveness of support interventions. Introduction Over the past several decades, significant progress has been made in the field of HIV care and treatment. With the introduction of highly active antiretroviral therapy (ART), individuals living with HIV are now able to achieve undetectable viral loads, live longer, and maintain an improved quality of life [1].

pmc-12573575.title: Comparative analysis of Bacillus pumilus TUAT1 endospores and vegetative cells: Implications for plant growth promotion and soil microbiome modulation
pmc-12573575.creator: Shin-ichiro Agake, Jean Louise Cocson Damo, Hiroki Rai, Gary Stacey, Michiko Yasuda, Naoko Ohkama-Ohtsu
pmc-12573575.description: Bacillus pumilus TUAT1, a gram-positive and spore-forming plant growth-promoting rhizobacterium, has been utilized as a biofertilizer due to its robust ability as spores to withstand environmental stresses and ensure long-term viability. This study investigated the mechanisms underlying the plant growth-promoting effects of spores and vegetative cells.

pmc-12975663.title: Rescaling of Distance Judgments With Geometric and Contextual Changes
pmc-12975663.creator: Ernest Simons, Caswell Barry, Caroline Whyatt, Rebecca Knight
pmc-12975663.description: Grid cells have been identified in the entorhinal cortex of rodents and humans, as well as other mammals. In rodents, these “distance computing” neurons exhibit altered firing fields in response to environmental manipulations, including changes to geometry or specific contextual cues (e.g., color).

pmc-13182233.title: Animal models for diabetic kidney disease: perspectives and prospects
pmc-13182233.creator: Min Zeng, Qin Gong, Hua Shen, Long Chen, Wanxia Zhang
pmc-13182233.description: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is one of the most severe complications of diabetes. Animal models of DKD play a crucial role in elucidating disease pathogenesis, exploring therapeutic strategies, and developing pharmacological interventions. This article systematically reviews the methodologies for establishing the four main categories of DKD animal models (induced, spontaneous, genetically engineered, and disease-syndrome combination models).

pmc-13305353.title: Developing an Interprofessional Framework for Culinary Nutrition and Culinary Medicine Competencies: A Consultation with International Experts
pmc-13305353.creator: Emma Stirling, Olivia Thomas, Sharon Croxford

pmc-13331145.title: Psychosocial experiences of adults living with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: a qualitative systematic review protocol
pmc-13331145.creator: A H M Fahad, N M Rabiul Awal Chowdhury, Salma Akter Urme
pmc-13331145.description: BackgroundAttention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a widely recognised mental health condition that frequently persists into adulthood, significantly impacting emotional well-being, interpersonal relationships, education and employment. Adults with ADHD often report substantial psychosocial challenges, including stigma, emotional dysregulation and occupational impairment. However, current literature has primarily concentrated on clinical diagnosis, comorbidities and treatment outcomes with a disproportionate emphasis on quantitative symptom-based metrics.

pmc-13343881.title: From out-of-pocket to prepaid financing? projected health expenditure and financing mix in Egypt, 1995–2050
pmc-13343881.creator: Moaz Elsayed Abouelmagd, Nereen A. Almosilhy, Asmaa Zakria Alnajjar, Marwa Biltagy

pmc-13479315.title: Outcomes of Intentional Celiac Artery Coverage During Thoracic Endovascular Aortic Repair for Infective Native Aortic Aneurysms: A Case Series
pmc-13479315.creator: Muhammad Aizat Tamlikha Ismail, Karthigesu Aimanan, Michael Arvind, Putera Mas Pian, Hanif Hussein
pmc-13479315.description: Intentional celiac artery (CA) coverage during thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR) may be required to achieve an adequate distal landing zone; however, this strategy remains controversial owing to concerns regarding visceral ischemia, particularly in patients with infective native aortic aneurysms with compromised physiology and hostile anatomy.

pmc-13547021.title: The mediating role of psychological factors in the relationship between body image dissatisfaction and eating disorders: a cross-sectional study in adults
pmc-13547021.creator: Nazlı Nur Aslan Çin, Murat Açık, Lina Begdache
pmc-13547021.description: Background/objectivesBody image disturbance is a well-established risk factor for eating disorders; however, the psychological mechanisms through which it exerts its influence remain insufficiently understood. This study examined the mediating roles of guilt, shame, anxiety, depression, and distress in the relationship between body image disturbance and eating disorder behaviors in adults.

pmc-13572595.title: 3D-printed scaffold-based strategies for enthesis regeneration: a systematic review of the literature
pmc-13572595.creator: Marco Minelli, Luca Bertolino, Vincenzo Longobardi, Simone Micalizzi, Federica Potere, Giuseppe Anzillotti, Tommaso Bonanzinga, Elizaveta Kon, Federico Della Rocca, Paolo Oliva
pmc-13572595.description: BackgroundThe enthesis is a specialized transitional tissue that enables load transfer between tendon and bone through a graded tendon–fibrocartilage–bone interface. Following injury or surgical repair, regeneration of the native enthesis remains challenging, often resulting in mechanically inferior fibrous scar tissue.

pmc-13576630.title: Oral Relapsing Lymphomatoid Papulosis: A Case Report
pmc-13576630.creator: A Bitton, P Le Gatt, S Barete, L Eck, P Reimbold, G Lescaille, N Gauthier, J Rochefort
pmc-13576630.description: Lymphomatoid papulosis (LyP) is a CD30+ T‐cell lymphoproliferative disorder rarely involving mucosa, where it may mimic aggressive lymphomas. This case highlights its chronic relapsing course, diagnostic challenges with ALK‐negative anaplastic T‐cell lymphoma, and the importance of long‐term follow‐up despite a favorable prognosis.
